senses.exampleCN: 能源用户今年冬天付得更多。
senses.why: The word follows anyone who takes something in.
senses.whyCN: 凡是把东西接进来用的人，这个词都跟着他。

intro.en: Consumer is the agent noun of consume, from Latin consumere, to use up, with the ending -er marking the person.
intro.cn: consumer 是 consume 的行为者名词，源自拉丁语 consumere（用尽），词尾 -er 表示人。

items.en: Sumere meant to take, and consumere meant to take completely.
items.cn: sumere 意为拿取，consumere 意为彻底取走。

items.en: The noun described one who uses something up.
items.cn: 相应的名词指把东西用掉的人。

items.en: French consumer kept the sense of using and wasting.
items.cn: 法语 consumer 保留使用与耗掉的意思。

items.en: English consumer first meant one who wastes or destroys.
items.cn: 英语 consumer 最初指耗掉或毁掉东西的人。

items.en: Economics gave it the sense of a buyer of goods.
items.cn: 经济学赋予它商品购买者的含义。

items.en: It now covers buyers, users and media audiences.
items.cn: 如今它涵盖购买者、使用者与媒体受众。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the consume- family, and the meaning group names other people on the buying side.
note.cn: 形近组共享 consume- 词族，近义组列出买方一侧的其他角色。

entries.definition: to use up goods, fuel or time
entries.definitionCN: 消耗；用尽

entries.definition: the amount of something that is used
entries.definitionCN: 消耗量；消费

entries.definition: a person who buys from a particular shop
entries.definitionCN: 顾客；客户

entries.definition: a person who buys something
entries.definitionCN: 购买者；买方

entries.definition: a person who uses a product or service
entries.definitionCN: 使用者；用户

entries.definition: a person or group that buys something
entries.definitionCN: 采购者；买主

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a shopping cart pushed down an aisle, then move to a hand comparing two price tags and to a bill paid at the door.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从推过货架的购物车开始，再到比较两个价签的那只手，最后到门口付掉的账单。

normal.en: Consume plus -er means the one who does the using up.
normal.cn: consume 加 -er，就是那个负责把东西用掉的人。

normal.en: A shopping cart is a consumer's small footprint.
normal.cn: 一辆购物车，就是消费者留下的小小脚印。

normal.en: The consumer pays, and the market listens.
normal.cn: 消费者掏钱，市场就听着。

normal.en: Every label is a promise made to a consumer.
normal.cn: 每一张标签，都是对消费者许下的承诺。

normal.en: One buyer is a person, many buyers are a force.
normal.cn: 一个买家是一个人，许多买家是一股力量。

abstract.en: Picture a hand turning a bottle to read the back label.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手转动瓶子去看背面的标签。

abstract.en: Picture a card tapped lightly on a small machine.
abstract.cn: 想象一张卡在小机器上轻轻一贴。

abstract.en: Picture a full trolley waiting at the checkout.
abstract.cn: 想象一辆装满的购物车在收银台前等候。

examples.en: Consumers are spending less on imported goods.
examples.cn: 消费者在进口商品上的花销减少了。

examples.en: The law protects consumers from false advertising.
examples.cn: 法律保护消费者免受虚假广告之害。

examples.en: Cheap packaging appeals to many consumers.
examples.cn: 简易包装对许多消费者有吸引力。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 consumer 记成 consume（消耗）加 er（人）：把商品买回去用掉的人，就是消费者。

root: 由 consume（用尽、消耗）加人称词尾 -er 构成，词根为拉丁语 consumere（彻底取走），后指购买并使用商品的消费者与用户。

sensesIntro.en: From the person pushing a cart, to the household that pays an energy bill.
sensesIntro.cn: 从推着购物车的人，到支付能源账单的那户人家。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a shopper comparing two bottles under a bright shelf.
core.cn: 核心意象：明亮的货架下，一位顾客比较着两个瓶子。

branches.en: The first sense is the person who buys with money.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是用钱买东西的人。

branches.en: The second sense widens to anyone who uses a service.
branches.cn: 第二个义项扩大到任何使用服务的人。

branches.en: Both senses describe the last link before a product is used.
branches.cn: 两个义项都描述产品被使用前的最后一环。

branches.en: Prices and labels are written for the buyer's eye.
branches.cn: 价格与标签都是写给买家的眼睛看的。

branches.en: A service consumer can complain, switch or simply leave.
branches.cn: 服务用户可以抱怨、更换，或者干脆离开。

intro.en: Consumer is consume plus the person ending -er, from Latin consumere, to use up.
intro.cn: consumer 是 consume 加人称词尾 -er，源自拉丁语 consumere（用尽）。

latinIntro.en: The Latin take base sum- also appears in assumption, resumption and presumption.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的拿取词基 sum- 也出现在 assumption、resumption 与 presumption 中。

items.meaning: a person who uses up goods
items.example: The consumer kept the receipt.
items.exampleCN: 那位消费者留下了小票。

items.example: The car consumes a lot of fuel.
items.exampleCN: 这辆车很费油。

items.example: Sugar consumption has fallen.
items.exampleCN: 糖的消费量已经下降。

items.meaning: a culture of buying more and more
items.example: Critics blame consumerism for the waste.
items.exampleCN: 批评者把浪费归咎于消费主义。

items.meaningCN: 支持以消费为中心的生活的
items.example: They reject a consumerist lifestyle.
items.exampleCN: 他们拒绝消费主义的生活方式。

items.example: We assume prices will stay low.
items.exampleCN: 我们假定价格会保持低位。

items.meaning: to take an activity up again
items.example: The shop resumed trading on Monday.
items.exampleCN: 那家店周一恢复营业。

items.meaningCN: 预先认定某事可能如此
items.example: I presume they will accept.
items.exampleCN: 我估计他们会接受。

definition_zh: 经销商；分销商；配电企业；（发动机的）分电器；分发者
definition_en: a firm or person that supplies goods to shops, or a device that sends current or content out to several points
core_image: 一只总水管分出许多支管，水从一处进来，被均匀送到各个出口
scene: 仓库门口停着几辆货车，一箱箱货被分到不同店铺的车上，每张运货单都写着各自的去处。 The distributor sends the cases to shops across the region.
sceneCN: 仓库月台上，货物按店铺分堆装车，一家公司把整批货拆开来分别送往各处；句中的 distributor 指「从生产商进货、再分送给各家店铺的经销商」（第 1 个义项：处在生产商与零售店之间、负责把货物分发出去的一方）。图中可辨识物件：货车、纸箱、运货单、仓库月台。

senses.title: Firm that supplies shops
senses.titleCN: 从生产商进货、再分送给店铺的经销商
senses.definition: a company that buys goods from producers and sells them on to shops rather than to the public
senses.definitionCN: 从生产商手中进货，再转售给店铺而不是卖给公众的公司
senses.example: The distributor supplies forty bookshops in the province.
senses.exampleCN: 这家经销商为省内四十家书店供货。
senses.why: the Latin verb behind it means to deal something out in portions, so the agent noun names the party that hands goods out piece by piece.
senses.whyCN: 其背后的拉丁语动词意为「按份分出」，因此施动名词指把货物一份份发出去的一方。

senses.title: Appointed seller of a brand
senses.titleCN: 获授权在某一地区销售某品牌的商家
senses.definition: a firm holding the right to sell a particular brand within a territory
senses.definitionCN: 在某一地区内拥有销售某个品牌权利的商家
senses.example: She became the authorised distributor for the brand in three countries.
senses.exampleCN: 她成为该品牌在三个国家的授权经销商。
senses.why: an exclusive contract turns an ordinary reseller into the officially appointed channel, and the word follows the contract.
senses.whyCN: 独家合同把普通的转售者变成官方指定的渠道，这个词也随之跟着合同走。

senses.title: Company that releases films
senses.titleCN: 把影片发行到影院的电影发行方
senses.definition: a company that arranges for a film or recording to reach cinemas and shops
senses.definitionCN: 安排影片或录音制品进入影院与商店的公司
senses.example: The film's distributor held back the release until spring.
senses.exampleCN: 该片的发行方把上映日期推迟到春天。
senses.why: films were once physically distributed in reels, so the entertainment trade kept the literal sense of handing copies outward.
senses.whyCN: 影片曾经以成卷胶片实物分发，娱乐业因此保留了「把拷贝发出去」的字面意思。

senses.title: Engine part that routes the spark
senses.titleCN: 把电流轮流送往各火花塞的分电器
senses.definition: a device in a petrol engine that sends the electric current to each spark plug in turn
senses.definitionCN: 在汽油发动机中把电流依次送往各个火花塞的装置
senses.example: A worn distributor cap made the engine misfire.
senses.exampleCN: 磨损的分电器盖使发动机点火失常。
senses.why: the part performs exactly what the name says: it deals one current out to several plugs in a fixed order.
senses.whyCN: 这个部件的功能正如其名：把同一股电流按固定顺序分给几个火花塞。

senses.title: Operator of the local power network
senses.titleCN: 把电或燃气送到用户的配电企业
senses.definition: a utility that carries electricity or gas from the main grid to individual homes and businesses
senses.definitionCN: 把电力或燃气从主干网输送到各户与各企业的公用事业公司
senses.example: The local distributor restored power within two hours.
senses.exampleCN: 本地配电企业在两小时内恢复了供电。
senses.why: the grid has a bulk transmission stage and a local delivery stage; the second stage hands energy to individual users, which is distribution.
senses.whyCN: 电网分为大宗输送与本地配送两个环节，后一个环节把能源交给单个用户，这就是分配。

senses.title: Person who hands things out
senses.titleCN: 把物资或文件分发给他人的办事人员
senses.definition: a person who gives out supplies, aid or papers to a group of people
senses.definitionCN: 把物资、援助或文件分发给一群人的工作人员
senses.example: A distributor of aid stood at the gate with a list of names.
senses.exampleCN: 一名负责分发援助物资的人拿着名单站在门口。
senses.why: the agent noun is older than the commercial sense and applies to any person who deals out shares.
senses.whyCN: 这个施动名词比商业义更早，适用于任何把份例分出去的人。

senses.title: Channel that spreads information
senses.titleCN: 把消息扩散到众人的渠道或机构
senses.definition: an agency or medium through which news or ideas reach a large audience
senses.definitionCN: 使新闻或观念传达到大量受众的机构或媒介
senses.example: Social platforms became the main distributor of the rumour.
senses.exampleCN: 社交平台成了这则谣言的主要传播渠道。
senses.why: the commercial sense widened: what is dealt out need not be goods but attention and information.
senses.whyCN: 商业义发生扩展：被分出去的不必是货物，也可以是注意力与信息。

senses.title: Service that delivers digital goods
senses.titleCN: 把软件或数字内容分发给用户的平台
senses.definition: a service that makes software, games or digital content available to users
senses.definitionCN: 把软件、游戏或数字内容提供给用户的服务平台
senses.example: The app distributor takes a share of every sale.
senses.exampleCN: 应用分发平台从每笔销售中抽取一份。
senses.why: digital goods are copied rather than shipped, yet the middle role survives because access still has to be granted.
senses.whyCN: 数字商品靠复制而不靠运输，但中间角色依然存在，因为获取权限仍需有人授予。

intro.en: Distributor comes from the Latin verb distribuere 'to deal out in portions', built on dis- 'apart' and tribuere 'to allot'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: distributor 来自拉丁语动词 distribuere「按份分出」，由表示「分开」的前缀与表示「分配」的词根构成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Tribuere meant 'to allot, assign, grant'. It is tied to tribus 'a division of the people', the source of the English word tribe; the deeper origin of tribus is not established.
items.cn: tribuere 意为「分配、分给、授予」。它与 tribus「人群的划分」相关，后者是英语中「部落」一词的来源；tribus 更早的来源未有定论。

items.en: Dis- 'apart' plus tribuere produced distribuere 'to divide up, deal out', the direct ancestor of the English verb distribute.
items.cn: 表示「分开」的前缀加 tribuere 构成 distribuere「分开、按份分出」，它是英语动词 distribute 的直接祖先。

items.en: The suffix -or names the one who performs the action, so distributor first meant any person who handed things out.
items.cn: 后缀表示动作的执行者，因此 distributor 最初指任何把东西分发出去的人。

items.en: In the nineteenth century the word settled on the firm standing between maker and shop, as trade grew too large for direct dealing.
items.cn: 到十九世纪，随着交易规模大到无法直接买卖，这个词固定指站在制造商与店铺之间的公司。

items.en: The petrol engine gave the word a mechanical branch: an ignition distributor deals one current out to several plugs.
items.cn: 汽油发动机给这个词添了一条机械分支：分电器把同一股电流分给几个火花塞。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper root): the link between tribuere and tribus is accepted, but the pre-Latin origin of tribus is unsettled, so any older form proposed for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词根）：tribuere 与 tribus 的关联已被接受，但 tribus 在拉丁语之前的来源没有定论，凡为其提出的更早形式均属重构。

note.en: Group one holds words built on the same Latin root that allot or assign; group two holds near neighbours in the supply chain.
note.cn: 第一组是同出「分配」这一拉丁词根、都含「分给」意思的词；第二组是供应链上语义相近的角色名。

entries.definition: Built with the prefix for 'together' and the allotting root: to give a share into a common fund or effort.
entries.definitionCN: 由表示「共同」的前缀与该分配词根构成：把一份力量或钱物放进共同的池子。

entries.definition: The prefix for 'to, toward' plus the allotting root: to assign a quality or cause to someone.
entries.definitionCN: 由表示「朝向」的前缀与该分配词根构成：把某种性质或原因归到某人身上。

entries.definition: From the same root, originally a sum allotted or paid to a ruler, later words or acts offered in respect.
entries.definitionCN: 同出该词根，原指分派或缴纳给统治者的款项，后指为表示敬意而献上的言辞或举动。

entries.definition: The prefix for 'back' plus the allotting root: a share dealt back as punishment.
entries.definitionCN: 由表示「回」的前缀与该分配词根构成：作为惩罚被回报的一份。

entries.definition: A firm that provides goods, often directly to the user; a distributor specifically resells to shops.
entries.definitionCN: 提供货物、常常直接卖给使用者的公司；distributor 特指转售给店铺的一方。

entries.definition: A person or firm trading in a particular class of goods, such as cars; it does not fix a place in the chain.
entries.definitionCN: 经营某一类商品（如汽车）的个人或公司，并不限定处在链条的哪一环。

entries.definition: The party that sells in a transaction, whether a market stall or a software company.
entries.definitionCN: 交易中出售的一方，可以是市场摊贩，也可以是软件公司。

entries.definition: Any trader between producer and buyer, of which a distributor is one kind.
entries.definitionCN: 任何处于生产者与买家之间的商人，经销商是其中一种。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real allotting root, the real word family and the real supply-chain phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的「分配」词根、真实词族与真实的供应链搭配。

normal.en: The root means 'to allot': a distributor allots portions of a shipment to different shops.
normal.cn: 词根意为「分配」：经销商把一批货分成份额，分给不同的店铺。

normal.en: The family moves through distribute, distribution, distributive and redistribution.
normal.cn: 同族词围绕「分配」展开，包括分发、分配、分配的形容词与再分配。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the trade: authorised distributor, exclusive distributor, distributor network.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出行业义：授权经销商、独家经销商、经销网络。

normal.en: The same root allots in contribute, attribute, tribute and retribution.
normal.cn: 同一词根在「贡献」「归因」「纳贡」「报应」中也表示分给。

normal.en: A distributor is not a shop: it sells to shops, and the shop sells to the public.
normal.cn: 经销商不是店铺：它把货卖给店铺，店铺才卖给公众。

abstract.en: Picture a single pipe splitting into many smaller pipes, each feeding a different street.
abstract.cn: 想象一根总管分成许多细管，每根细管通向不同街道。

abstract.en: Picture a hand dealing cards face down to every player at a table.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把牌一张张扣着发给桌边的每位玩家。

abstract.en: Picture a pump that pushes the same current to several lamps in turn.
abstract.cn: 想象一台泵把同一股电流轮流推给几盏灯。

examples.en: A distributor buys in bulk and never sells a single item to a walk-in customer.
examples.cn: 经销商整批进货，从不把单件商品卖给散客。

examples.en: The book's distributor ships to shops, while the publisher deals with the author.
examples.cn: 书的发行方把书发给店铺，出版社则与作者打交道。

examples.en: In an old engine, the distributor decides which plug fires next.
examples.cn: 在老式发动机里，分电器决定下一个点火的是哪个火花塞。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「dis（分开）+ tribute（分配）」——把货分开分给各家店 → 经销商、分销商

root: 拉丁语 distribuere（按份分出）＝表示「分开」的前缀＋tribuere（分配、分给）。词根又与 tribus（人群的划分）相关，tribus 更早来源无定论。英语 distributor 由该动词加表施动者的后缀构成。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one gesture: one quantity is split into portions and sent to several receivers, whether the portions are crates, films, sparks or news.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个动作展开：把一份总量拆成若干份，送往不同的接收者；被拆开的可以是货箱、影片、电火花或消息。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one inlet splitting into many outlets, each receiving a share.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个入口分出许多出口，每个出口各得一份。

branches.en: GOODS CHANNEL: goods or brand rights pass from maker to shop through one appointed hand.
branches.cn: 货物渠道：货物或品牌权利经一只被指定的手从制造商流向店铺。

branches.en: CONTENT CHANNEL: reels and app downloads are released rather than shipped, yet access is still granted by a middle party.
branches.cn: 内容渠道：胶片与下载不靠运输而靠发行，但获取权限仍由中间方授予。

branches.en: CURRENT: sparks and mains power prove that the share being dealt out may be pure energy.
branches.cn: 电流：火花与市电说明，被分出去的份额可以是纯粹的能量。

branches.en: PERSON: before firms existed, the word simply named a person handing out shares.
branches.cn: 人：在公司出现之前，这个词只指把份额分出去的人。

branches.en: INFORMATION: attention is the last thing dealt out, and the role survives without any physical goods.
branches.cn: 信息：注意力是最后一种被分出去的东西，角色在没有实物时依然成立。

intro.en: The word is a Latin prefix, a Latin root and an agent suffix; all three recur in ordinary English.
intro.cn: 这个词由一个拉丁前缀、一个拉丁词根与一个表施动者的后缀组成，三部分都在日常英语中反复出现。

latinIntro.en: Latin tribuere gives contribute, attribute, tribute and retribution; the prefix marks separation.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tribuere 衍生出「贡献」「归因」「纳贡」与「报应」等词；前缀标出「分开」的方向。

items.example: The prefix says the portions go to separate places.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀表示各份被送往不同地方。

items.structure: tribuere, tribui, tributum (Latin verb, third conjugation)
items.example: The root carries the idea of handing out shares.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根带着「分发份额」的意思。

items.example: Distribuere names the act behind the English word.
items.exampleCN: distribuere 点明英语词背后的动作。

items.example: Volunteers distribute the kits at the gate.
items.exampleCN: 志愿者在门口分发物资包。

items.meaning: the act or pattern of handing out
items.example: The distribution of the grant was uneven.
items.exampleCN: 这笔拨款的分配并不均衡。

items.meaning: the one that hands goods out
items.meaningCN: 把货物分发出去的一方
items.example: The distributor supplies forty shops.
items.exampleCN: 这家经销商为四十家店铺供货。

items.example: The scheme had a distributive aim.
items.exampleCN: 该方案带有分配方面的目的。

items.example: Tax and benefits produce redistribution.
items.exampleCN: 税收与福利带来再分配。

latinEntries.meaning: a division of the people, tribe

definition_zh: 物流；后勤；物流学
definition_en: the detailed organisation of moving, storing and supplying things, especially for an army or a large business
core_image: 仓库里叉车按路线取货，货车在月台排队，调度员盯着屏幕上每一票货物的位置
scene: 仓库里叉车按路线取货，货车在月台排队，调度员盯着屏幕上每一票货物的位置。 Good logistics kept the relief supplies moving through three flooded counties.
sceneCN: 句中的说法指「把货物运输、仓储与调度组织起来的实务」（第 1 个义项：使货物按时到达的整体安排）；句意为良好的物流让救援物资穿过三个受淹的县。图中可辨识物件：叉车、月台、排队的货车、调度屏。

pos.zh: 物流；后勤（不可数，形式为复数）

senses.title: The organisation of moving goods
senses.titleCN: 货物运输与仓储的组织
senses.definition: the practical work of moving, storing and delivering goods so that they arrive on time
senses.definitionCN: 使货物按时到达的运输、仓储与交付实务
senses.example: Good logistics kept the relief supplies moving through three flooded counties.
senses.exampleCN: 良好的物流让救援物资穿过三个受淹的县。
senses.why: The word names the practical art of arranging movement and supply, which is its broad modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 这个词指安排运输与供给的实务本领，这是它宽泛的现代义。

senses.title: Military supply and movement
senses.definition: the branch of military work that moves troops, food, fuel and ammunition
senses.definitionCN: 负责调动部队、粮食、燃料与弹药的军事工作
senses.example: The campaign failed for logistics, not for courage.
senses.exampleCN: 这场战役败在后勤，而不是败在勇气。
senses.why: The modern word entered English through military writing, where supply and movement decide what an army can do.
senses.whyCN: 这个现代词经军事写作进入英语，因为在军中供给与调动决定了部队能做什么。

senses.title: The business function
senses.definition: the department or function in a firm that plans transport, storage and delivery
senses.definitionCN: 企业内规划运输、仓储与交付的部门或职能
senses.example: Logistics reports to the operations director.
senses.exampleCN: 物流部门向运营总监汇报。
senses.why: A department is named after the work it performs, so the office that moves goods is called logistics too.
senses.whyCN: 部门以它所做的工作命名，因此搬运货物的部门也叫物流。

senses.title: The arrangements behind an event
senses.definition: the practical arrangements of people, equipment and timing that let an event happen
senses.definitionCN: 使一场活动得以进行的人员、设备与时间安排
senses.example: The wedding ran late because of logistics, not the food.
senses.exampleCN: 婚礼延误是安排问题，不是食物问题。
senses.why: Anything that must be moved and timed needs the same kind of planning, so the word spread from armies to events.
senses.whyCN: 凡是需要搬运与计时的事都需要同类规划，因此这个词从军队扩到活动。

senses.title: The academic subject
senses.definition: the study of flows, using models from operations research and management
senses.definitionCN: 用运筹与管理模型研究流动的学科
senses.example: Logistics borrows models from operations research.
senses.exampleCN: 物流学从运筹学借用模型。
senses.why: When practice becomes teachable, its name becomes the name of a subject.
senses.whyCN: 当实务变得可教，它的名字就成了学科的名字。

senses.title: Transport and delivery in practice
senses.definition: the daily execution of carrying goods, including routing and scheduling
senses.definitionCN: 日常执行运货，包括路线与排班
senses.example: Retail logistics adds a delivery shift at midnight.
senses.exampleCN: 零售物流在午夜增加一个配送班次。
senses.why: The plan has to be carried out on roads, so the daily run keeps the same name as the plan.
senses.whyCN: 规划必须落到道路上执行，因此每日运行沿用规划的名称。

senses.title: Warehousing and stock control
senses.definition: the part of the work that holds goods and keeps records of them
senses.definitionCN: 保管货物并记录其数量的那部分工作
senses.example: Cold-chain logistics needs a warehouse at every border.
senses.exampleCN: 冷链物流需要在每道边境设一个仓库。
senses.why: Goods must stand still somewhere, and holding them is part of moving them.
senses.whyCN: 货物总要在某处停留，保管它们是搬运的一部分。

senses.title: Emergency supply dispatch
senses.definition: the rapid arranging of supplies in a disaster, where time and access are limited
senses.definitionCN: 在灾害中时间与通路受限时快速安排物资
senses.example: Disaster logistics moves water before it moves food.
senses.exampleCN: 灾害物流先运水，再运食物。
senses.why: When roads and time collapse, the same art is practised under extreme constraint and takes a limiting word in front.
senses.whyCN: 当道路与时间都崩塌，同一门本领在极端约束下施展，于是前面加上限定词。

intro.en: Logistics has two suggested backgrounds: a French word for lodging troops and a Greek word for reckoning. The modern military sense is French, and Greek influence is often claimed but not proved. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: 这个词有两条被提出的来源：法语中表示「安置部队住宿」的词，以及希腊语中表示「计算」的词。近代军事义出自法语；希腊语的影响常被主张，但未获证实。年代均为约数。

items.en: Loger meant 'to lodge, to quarter'. It came from loge 'hut, shelter', whose own origin is uncertain, possibly Germanic.
items.cn: loger 意为「安置住宿、驻扎」。它出自 loge「小屋、住所」，后者自身来源不确定，可能出自日耳曼语。

items.en: Greek logistikos meant 'skilled in reckoning', from logizesthai 'to reckon' and logos 'word, reason'. It described calculation, not transport.
items.cn: 希腊语 logistikos 意为「善于计算」，出自 logizesthai「计算」与 logos「言词、理性」。它描述的是计算，而非运输。

items.en: Eighteenth-century French logistique named the art of moving and supplying troops. This military sense is the documented source of the English word.
items.cn: 十八世纪法语 logistique 指调动与供给部队的技艺。这一军事义是英语词有书证的来源。

items.en: The resemblance to the Greek word for reckoning is often cited as an influence on the French term, but no direct derivation has been shown, so the link remains a hypothesis.
items.cn: 它与希腊语「计算」一词的相似常被认为是影响法语术语的因素，但并无直接派生关系被证明，因此这一联系仍属假说。

items.en: English borrowed the word in the nineteenth century for military supply, and business adopted it in the twentieth for the flow of goods.
items.cn: 英语在十九世纪借这个词指军事供给，二十世纪商业又用它指货物流转。

note.en: Group one holds forms of the same word in other roles; group two holds words for parts of the same practical work.
note.cn: 第一组是同一个词的其他词类形式；第二组是表示同一实务各环节的词。

entries.definition: Relating to logistics; in mathematics the same shape of word names a curve, which is a separate specialist usage.
entries.definitionCN: 指与物流有关的；数学中同一词形的词指一种曲线，属另一专门用法。

entries.definition: A variant adjective used before nouns such as support or problem.
entries.definitionCN: 较长的形容词变体，用于支持、问题等名词之前。

entries.definition: Used of feasibility in terms of transport and supply, as in logistically impossible.
entries.definitionCN: 从运输与供给角度谈可行性，如「在物流上不可能」。

entries.definition: One who studies formal logic, from the Greek word for reason; it looks close but belongs to argument, not freight.
entries.definitionCN: 指研究形式逻辑的人，出自希腊语「理性」一词；形似但属于论证，而非货运。

entries.definition: The movement of finished goods to points of sale; logistics also covers incoming supply and storage.
entries.definitionCN: 把成品送到销售点，而物流还包括进货与仓储。

entries.definition: Goods carried by a carrier, or the charge for carrying them, not the planning.
entries.definitionCN: 指承运的货物或运费，不含规划。

entries.definition: Obtaining goods and services, which happens before they are moved.
entries.definitionCN: 指获取商品与服务，发生在运输之前。

entries.definition: The full sequence of firms and steps; logistics is the work of keeping that path moving.
entries.definitionCN: 指企业与人手的完整序列；物流是让这条路径保持流动的工作。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The word entered English through the military art of moving and supplying troops.
normal.cn: 这个词经「调动与供给部队」的军事技艺进入英语。

normal.en: The family runs the adjective, its longer variant, the adverb and the name for a practitioner.
normal.cn: 同族词包括形容词、其较长变体、副词，以及从业者的称呼。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the field: logistics company, costs, network, military logistics, last-mile delivery.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出领域：物流公司、物流成本、物流网络、军事后勤、末端配送。

normal.en: The same planning serves armies, factories, hospitals and weddings, because all of them must move things on time.
normal.cn: 同一套规划服务军队、工厂、医院与婚礼，因为它们都必须按时搬运东西。

normal.en: Storage and records are part of the work, which is why warehouses appear wherever the word is used.
normal.cn: 仓储与记录也是这项工作的一部分，因此这个词出现的地方总有仓库。

abstract.en: Picture a map with routes drawn on it and a clock in every corner.
abstract.cn: 想象一张画满路线的地图，每个角落都有一只钟。

abstract.en: Picture a lorry queue at a ramp, each one waiting for its turn.
abstract.cn: 想象月台前排队的货车，每一辆都在等自己的次序。

abstract.en: Picture water arriving before food in a place where roads are gone.
abstract.cn: 想象在道路消失的地方，水比食物先到。

examples.en: The company cut logistics costs by loading full trucks.
examples.cn: 公司靠装满整车降低了物流成本。

examples.en: Military logistics decides how far an army can march.
examples.cn: 军事后勤决定一支军队能走多远。

examples.en: She studied logistics before joining the port authority.
examples.cn: 她在进入港务局之前学过物流。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「log（安置）+ istics（事务）」——把人和货安置到位的事务 → 后勤、物流

root: 这个词有两条被提出的背景：法语中表示「安置住宿」的动词（出自表示「小屋」的名词，来源不确定），以及希腊语中表示「善于计算」的词；近代军事义有书证地出自法语，希腊语影响仍属假说。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one practical art: goods are moved, an army is supplied, a firm keeps a function, an event is arranged, the subject is studied, routes are run daily, stock is held, and finally supplies are rushed into a disaster.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一门实务展开：货被运走、军队被供给、企业设有职能、活动被安排、学科被研究、路线每天执行、库存被保管，最后物资被抢送进灾区。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a forklift following a marked route in a warehouse while lorries wait at the ramp and a screen shows where every parcel is.
core.cn: 核心意象：叉车在仓库里沿标记路线取货，货车在月台等候，屏幕上显示每个包裹的位置。

branches.en: THE EVERYDAY WORK: the general art of moving and storing goods is the broad modern sense.
branches.cn: 日常实务：运输与仓储的整体本领，是宽泛的现代义。

branches.en: FROM THE FIELD TO THE CLASSROOM: supplying an army and studying flows share one body of method.
branches.cn: 从战场到课堂：供给军队与研究流动，共用一套方法。

branches.en: INSIDE THE FIRM: a department and a warehouse are the same function given an office and a building.
branches.cn: 企业之内：部门与仓库，是同一职能有了办公室与建筑。

branches.en: BEYOND THE FIRM: an event and a disaster both need things moved on time under pressure.
branches.cn: 企业之外：活动与灾害都需要在压力下按时搬运东西。

branches.en: THE DAILY RUN: routes and shifts are where the planning meets the road.
branches.cn: 每日运转：路线与班次是规划与道路相接之处。

intro.en: Logistics is a French military noun with a disputed Greek neighbour; its endings are plural in form but singular in use, and its family supplies the adjectives and the practitioner's name.
intro.cn: 这是一个法语军事名词，旁边还有一个来源有争议的希腊词；它的词尾形式是复数而用法为单数，其词族提供形容词与从业者的称呼。

latinIntro.en: The word is French in documented origin and has no Latin relative; the Greek word for reckoning is a claimed influence rather than a proven source.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词有书证的来源是法语，在拉丁语中没有同族词；希腊语中表示「计算」的词只被主张为影响来源，并未证明为来源。

items.example: Its own origin is uncertain, possibly Germanic.
items.exampleCN: 其自身来源不确定，可能出自日耳曼语。

items.example: The verb described where soldiers slept before it described where supplies went.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词先说士兵睡在哪里，后说补给去哪里。

items.meaning: the art of moving and supplying troops
items.meaningCN: 调动与供给部队的技艺
items.example: The military sense is the documented source of the English word.
items.exampleCN: 军事义是英语词有书证的来源。

items.example: The suffix makes a name for a body of practical method.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀为成套实务方法造出名称。

items.structure: -s (English plural ending used as a singular noun)
items.meaning: a body of work treated as one subject
items.meaningCN: 被当作一门学问的整体工作
items.example: The plural form names one field, like other subject names.
items.exampleCN: 这个复数形式指一门领域，如同其他学科名称。

items.example: The adjective drops the plural ending.
items.exampleCN: 形容词去掉了复数词尾。

items.example: A longer variant used before nouns of support and problem.
items.exampleCN: 较长的变体，用于支持、问题等名词前。

items.example: The person suffix names the practitioner.
items.exampleCN: 表示人的后缀指从业者。

definition_zh: 存货；库存；清单、目录；盘点；（把……）列入清单
definition_en: goods held in stock, or a full list of items recorded one by one
core_image: 仓库门被拉开，每一格里的东西都被记在同一张表上，表与实物一一对应
scene: 盘点员拿着表走过货架，把每一格的数量念出来，表上的数字与格子里的实物一一对上。 The inventory showed far more unsold stock than the accounts suggested.
sceneCN: 盘点员沿货架逐格清点，把数量记在表上，纸面数字与实物一一对应；句中的 inventory 指「仓中现存的全部存货」（第 1 个义项：尚未售出、实际存放在库的商品与原料）。图中可辨识物件：盘点表、货架、纸箱、记号笔。

senses.title: Goods held in stock
senses.definition: the goods and materials a business keeps on hand for sale or production
senses.definitionCN: 企业为出售或生产而现存的货物与原料
senses.example: The inventory showed far more unsold stock than the accounts suggested.
senses.exampleCN: 盘点显示未售出的存货远多于账面上的数字。
senses.why: the word first meant a list of what was found, and the goods on the list took over the name.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指「找到之物」的清单，清单上的货物后来接管了这个名字。

senses.title: A list of items
senses.titleCN: 逐项列出的清单或目录
senses.definition: a detailed list of goods, property or objects, item by item
senses.definitionCN: 逐项开列货物、财产或物品的详细清单
senses.example: The museum keeps an inventory of every coin in the vault.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆为库房里的每一枚硬币留有清单。
senses.why: this is the oldest sense: an inventory is literally that which has been come upon and written down.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项：清单字面上就是「被发现并记下来」的东西。

senses.title: Stock as an asset
senses.titleCN: 会计上列为资产的存货
senses.definition: the value of unsold goods carried as a current asset on a balance sheet
senses.definitionCN: 未售货物作为流动资产列在资产负债表上的价值
senses.example: Slow inventory tied up the company's cash for a year.
senses.exampleCN: 滞销库存把公司的现金占用了一整年。
senses.why: accounting turns the physical stock into a number, and keeps the same word for it.
senses.whyCN: 会计把实物存货变成一个数字，却仍用同一个词来称呼。

senses.title: The act of counting stock
senses.definition: the process of counting and checking everything held in stock
senses.definitionCN: 逐件清点并核对库存的过程
senses.example: The shop closes early on the last day for inventory.
senses.exampleCN: 店铺在盘点那天提前关门。
senses.why: the noun of result became a noun of action, as happens with many words for lists and records.
senses.whyCN: 结果名词变成了动作名词，这在许多表示清单与记录的词中都会发生。

senses.title: To list and count
senses.titleCN: 编制清单、逐项清点（动词）
senses.definition: to make a complete list of something or to count stock item by item
senses.definitionCN: 为某物编制完整清单，或逐件清点存货
senses.example: Staff inventoried the shelves before the refit.
senses.exampleCN: 改装之前，员工清点了货架上的货。
senses.why: the verb simply applies the list-making act to the object being listed.
senses.whyCN: 动词只是把「造清单」的动作施加到被列的对象上。

senses.title: Stock management as a function
senses.titleCN: 作为管理职能的库存控制
senses.definition: the function of deciding how much stock to hold and when to reorder
senses.definitionCN: 决定持有多少存货、何时补货的管理职能
senses.example: Inventory control cut the average holding time by half.
senses.exampleCN: 库存控制把平均持有时间缩短了一半。
senses.why: once stock is measured, it can be managed, and the word attaches to that managerial function.
senses.whyCN: 存货一旦可以计量，就可以被管理，这个词于是附在这一管理职能上。

senses.title: A scored questionnaire
senses.titleCN: 心理学中逐项评分的人格量表
senses.definition: a set of scored questions used to measure traits such as personality or depression
senses.definitionCN: 用逐项评分来测量人格或抑郁等特征的一套题目
senses.example: The personality inventory flagged high anxiety but normal mood.
senses.exampleCN: 这份人格量表显示焦虑偏高，情绪则属正常。
senses.why: psychology borrowed the list sense: a person is checked item by item, as goods are on a shelf.
senses.whyCN: 心理学借用了清单义：人被逐项核对，正如货架上的货被逐件清点。

senses.title: A full assessment of one's resources
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：对自身资源与处境的全面清点
senses.definition: a careful review of what one has, whether skills, debts or memories
senses.definitionCN: 对自己拥有之物——技能、债务或记忆——的仔细梳理
senses.example: At fifty she took inventory of her life and changed course.
senses.exampleCN: 五十岁时她清点了自己的人生，随后改变了方向。
senses.why: the image of counting every item generalizes to counting everything one has, including what cannot be seen.
senses.whyCN: 逐件清点的意象被一般化，用来数自己拥有的一切，包括看不见的东西。

intro.en: Inventory comes from Medieval Latin inventorium 'a list of things found', built on the Latin verb invenire 'to come upon, find'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: inventory 来自中世纪拉丁语 inventorium「所列之物的清单」，其词根是拉丁语动词 invenire「遇到、发现」。年代均为约数。

items.en: Venire 'to come' is the base verb; the prefix in- adds the idea of coming upon something.
items.cn: venire「来」是基础动词，前缀 in- 增添「碰上、遇到」的意思。

items.en: Invenire meant 'to come upon, find, discover', and its participle inventum supplied the stem of the later noun.
items.cn: invenire 意为「遇到、找到、发现」，其分词 inventum 提供了后来名词的词干。

items.en: Medieval Latin inventorium named a written list of goods or property found on an estate, drawn up item by item.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 inventorium 指对某处产业中查得之物逐项开列的书面清单。

items.en: English adopted the word in the fifteenth century for such a list, and later for the goods themselves and the act of counting them.
items.cn: 英语在十五世纪采用这个词指这类清单，后来又用它指货物本身以及清点的动作。

items.en: With industrial retailing, inventory became a managed asset, and the word moved into accounting, logistics and computing.
items.cn: 随着工业化零售，存货成为被管理的资产，这个词也进入会计、物流与计算机领域。

note.en: Group one holds words from the same 'find' root that are often confused; group two holds words for goods held or for lists.
note.cn: 第一组同出「发现」这一词根，常被混淆；第二组指持有之物或清单。

entries.definition: The same verb 'to come upon': to devise something that did not exist, originally to find it out.
entries.definitionCN: 同出「遇到」这一动词：创造出原先没有的东西，原义是把它找出来。

entries.definition: The act or product of devising something new, from the same stem as inventory.
entries.definitionCN: 设计出新事物的动作或产物，与 inventory 同出一个词干。

entries.definition: The one who devises something new; the ending marks a person, where inventory marks a list.
entries.definitionCN: 设计出新事物的人；词尾标记人，而 inventory 标记清单。

entries.definition: Able to devise new things, built on the same stem with an adjective suffix.
entries.definitionCN: 能够设计出新事物的，由同一词干加形容词后缀构成。

entries.definition: Goods kept for sale, the usual British term where American business says inventory.
entries.definitionCN: 为出售而持有的货物；英式常用这个词，美式商业则用 inventory。

entries.definition: A large store built up deliberately, often of essentials; it stresses accumulation over routine stock.
entries.definitionCN: 有意囤积的大量储备，常指必需品；强调积累而非日常库存。

entries.definition: A list of items arranged for reference or sale; an inventory is a list for checking and control.
entries.definitionCN: 为查阅或销售而编排的物品清单；inventory 是为核对与控制而作的清单。

entries.definition: The book of accounts; an inventory counts goods, a ledger records money.
entries.definitionCN: 账册；inventory 清点货物，ledger 记录钱款。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real 'find' root, the real business phrases and the real psychological use.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的「发现」词根、真实的商业搭配与真实的心理测量用法。

normal.en: The root means 'to come upon': an inventory is what you find when you go through every shelf.
normal.cn: 词根意为「遇到、发现」：清单就是你走遍每个货架后查到的东西。

normal.en: The family runs invent, invention, inventor and inventive, all from the same 'find' stem.
normal.cn: 同族词包括发明、发明物、发明家与有创造力的，都出同一「发现」词干。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark it: inventory control, inventory turnover, take inventory.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出这个词：库存控制、存货周转、盘点。

normal.en: British shops say stock where American accounts say inventory.
normal.cn: 英国店铺多说 stock，美国会计多说 inventory。

normal.en: A personality inventory checks a person item by item, like goods on a shelf.
normal.cn: 人格量表逐项检查一个人，正如逐件清点货架上的货。

abstract.en: Picture a clipboard that turns a room full of objects into numbered lines.
abstract.cn: 想象一块写字板，把满屋的东西变成一行行编号。

abstract.en: Picture a life laid out on a table and counted like coins.
abstract.cn: 想象一段人生被摊在桌上，像硬币一样被清点。

abstract.en: Picture a warehouse whose shelves are questions rather than boxes.
abstract.cn: 想象一座仓库，货架上放的不是箱子而是问题。

examples.en: The warehouse holds two months of inventory at all times.
examples.cn: 这座仓库始终保有两个月的存货。

examples.en: They took inventory and found a third of the stock missing.
examples.cn: 他们盘点后发现三分之一的存货不见了。

examples.en: Inventory turnover tells you how quickly goods are sold.
examples.cn: 存货周转率说明货物卖得有多快。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「in（在内）+ vent（来）+ ory」——把里面查到的东西都记下来 → 清单、存货

root: 中世纪拉丁语 inventorium（查得之物的清单）来自拉丁语 invenire（遇到、找到）＝in-（向内、在上）＋venire（来）。同族词有 invent、invention、inventor。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses begin with a list of things found and then follow the goods on that list into accounting, management, psychology and finally into a private accounting of one's own life.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从「查得之物的清单」开始，再让清单上的货物走进会计、管理、心理学，最后走进一个人对自己人生的私下清点。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a clipboard that turns a room of objects into numbered lines.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块写字板，把满屋物品变成一行行编号。

branches.en: FOUND AND LISTED: the goods and the list are two sides of the same act of finding.
branches.cn: 查到并记下：货物与清单是同一个「查」的动作的两面。

branches.en: MEASURED AND MANAGED: once counted, stock becomes an asset and then a function.
branches.cn: 计量与管理：一旦被清点，存货就成为资产，随后成为一项职能。

branches.en: THE COUNT ITSELF: the noun of result turns into a noun and then a verb of counting.
branches.cn: 清点本身：结果名词转为动作名词，再转为动词。

branches.en: A PERSON SCORED: psychology counts a person as a shop counts goods.
branches.cn: 被评分的人：心理学数人，正如店铺数货。

branches.en: ONE'S OWN LEDGER: the last count is of resources that never sat on a shelf.
branches.cn: 自己的账：最后一次清点的是从未上过货架的资源。

intro.en: The word is a Latin prefix, a Latin verb and a medieval noun ending, and the family is shared with invention.
intro.cn: 这个词由一个拉丁前缀、一个拉丁动词与一个中世纪名词词尾构成，与「发明」一族共享词干。

latinIntro.en: Latin venire gives invent, invention and inventory; the prefix marks finding, and the ending marks a place or collection.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 venire 衍生出「发明」「发明物」与「清单」；前缀标记「找到」，词尾标记处所或集合。

items.example: The prefix turns coming into coming upon something.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把「来」变成「碰上某物」。

items.structure: venire, veni, ventum (Latin verb, fourth conjugation)
items.example: The root is the plain verb of motion.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根就是表示移动的普通动词。

items.example: Invenire is the act behind both invention and inventory.
items.exampleCN: 这个词既是「发明」也是「清单」背后的动作。

items.example: The participle supplies the noun stem.
items.exampleCN: 这个分词提供了名词词干。

items.example: The medieval list named every item on the estate.
items.exampleCN: 这份中世纪清单列出了产业上的每一项。

items.example: The inventory filled three pages.
items.exampleCN: 这份清单写满了三页。

items.example: She invented a quieter pump.
items.exampleCN: 她发明了一种更安静的泵。

items.meaning: the act or product of devising
items.example: The invention changed the trade.
items.exampleCN: 这项发明改变了这个行业。

items.example: Every crate was inventoried.
items.exampleCN: 每一只箱子都被登记在册。

latinEntries.structure: inventorium, inventori (n., second declension, Medieval Latin)

definition_zh: 关税；税率表；（公用事业）价目表
definition_en: a tax on goods entering a country, a published table of such rates, or a schedule of charges for a service
core_image: 海关窗口上贴着一张长表，每一行写着一种货物与一个百分比，关员用笔在表上划线
scene: 海关窗口上贴着一张长表，每一行写着一种货物与一个百分比，关员用笔在表上划线。 The government raised the tariff on imported steel.
sceneCN: 这里这个词指「对进口货物征收的税」（第 1 个义项：进口关税）；句意为政府对进口钢材提高了关税。图中可辨识物件：长表、货物名称、百分比、关员的笔。

pos.zh: 关税；税率表；（水、电、通信的）价目表
对……征收关税；按价目表收费（较少用）

derivatives.zh: 制定税率；按价目表收费

senses.title: A tax on imported goods
senses.definition: a charge collected at the border on goods coming into a country
senses.definitionCN: 在边境对进入一国的货物收取的费用
senses.example: The tariff on imported steel doubled overnight.
senses.exampleCN: 进口钢材的关税一夜之间翻了一倍。
senses.why: The word came to mean a published list of charges, and the charge for imports became its central sense.
senses.whyCN: 这个词本指一份公布的收费表，而对进口的收费成了它最核心的义项。

senses.title: The published schedule of rates
senses.definition: the official table that lists each kind of goods and the rate charged on it
senses.definitionCN: 列出各类货物及所征税率的官方表格
senses.example: The customs office keeps the tariff in a thick bound volume.
senses.exampleCN: 海关把税则保存在一本厚厚的大册里。
senses.why: A tax needs a table before it can be collected, and the table shares the name.
senses.whyCN: 税在征收之前需要一张表，这张表便与税共用同一个名字。

senses.title: A protective tariff
senses.definition: a duty set high enough to shield domestic producers from foreign competition
senses.definitionCN: 高到足以让本国生产者免受外国竞争冲击的关税
senses.example: The protective tariff kept the local mills open for a decade.
senses.exampleCN: 保护性关税让本地磨坊多开了十年。
senses.why: A toll can be set not to raise money but to keep traffic out.
senses.whyCN: 一道收费门可以不为收钱，而为把车流挡在外面。

senses.title: A retaliatory tariff
senses.definition: a duty imposed in answer to another country's duty
senses.definitionCN: 为回应另一国的关税而施加的关税
senses.example: The retaliatory tariff hit fruit from the neighbouring market.
senses.exampleCN: 报复性关税打击了邻国市场的水果。
senses.why: When a toll is charged against you, the answer is another toll.
senses.whyCN: 当别人对你收过路费，回答就是再收一道。

senses.title: The rate itself, whether by value or by unit
senses.titleCN: 税率本身，按价值或按数量计
senses.definition: the percentage of value or the fixed sum per unit that the duty amounts to
senses.definitionCN: 关税所折算成的价值百分比或每单位固定金额
senses.example: The tariff rate is charged on the value stated on the invoice.
senses.exampleCN: 税率按发票上申报的价值征收。
senses.why: Behind the table sits a number, and that number is what officials actually apply.
senses.whyCN: 表格背后是一个数字，官员实际适用的正是那个数字。

senses.title: A utility's schedule of charges
senses.definition: the published list of rates for electricity, gas, water or telephone service
senses.definitionCN: 电力、燃气、水或电话服务公布的费率表
senses.example: The night tariff makes off-peak power cheaper.
senses.exampleCN: 夜间电价表让非高峰用电更便宜。
senses.why: The same word for a published rate table serves any service that bills by a schedule.
senses.whyCN: 同一个表示公布费率表的词，适用于任何按表计费的服务。

senses.title: A tariff war between countries
senses.definition: a cycle in which each side raises duties in response to the other
senses.definitionCN: 双方互相提高关税以回应对方的循环
senses.example: The tariff war raised prices on both sides of the border.
senses.exampleCN: 关税战抬高了两国边境两侧的价格。
senses.why: Repeated retaliation turns a single duty into a sustained conflict.
senses.whyCN: 反复报复把单项关税变成持续冲突。

senses.title: A general price list or fee schedule
senses.titleCN: 一般的价目表或收费表
senses.definition: any table of charges, as for a hotel, a taxi service or a repair shop
senses.definitionCN: 任何收费表，如旅馆、出租车或修理店的价目表
senses.example: The hotel keeps its tariff on a card behind the door.
senses.exampleCN: 旅馆把价目表放在门后的卡片上。
senses.why: This is the oldest surviving sense: a list of prices printed to be read.
senses.whyCN: 这是留存下来的最早义项：一份印出来供人查看的价格清单。

intro.en: Tariff came into English through Italian and French from Arabic tarif, a notification or an assessment, from the verb meaning to know. The sense of a duty grew out of the published list of charges.
intro.cn: tariff 经意大利语与法语进入英语，来自阿拉伯语中表示「通告、估定」的词，其动词意为「知道」。关税义由公布的收费表发展而来。

items.en: The verb meant to know or to inform, and from it came the noun for a notification or an assessment.
items.cn: 这个动词意为「知道、告知」，由其产生表示「通告、估定」的名词。

items.en: Tarif named a statement of charges or a list of prices, the sense that travelled into Europe.
items.cn: tarif 指一份收费说明或价格清单，这一义项传入欧洲。

items.en: Italian tariffa kept the sense of a schedule of charges, used in ports and customs houses.
items.cn: 意大利语 tariffa 保留「收费表」之义，用于港口与海关。

items.en: French tarif carried the word onward, and English borrowed it in the sixteenth century.
items.cn: 法语 tarif 继续传递这个词，英语在十六世纪借入。

items.en: In English the word first meant a table of rates, then the duty charged according to that table.
items.cn: 在英语中，这个词先指费率表，后指按该表征收的税。

items.en: In the nineteenth and twentieth centuries gas, water and telephone companies published their own tariffs, keeping the older list sense alive.
items.cn: 十九与二十世纪，燃气、水与电话公司各自公布价目表，使较旧的「清单」义得以延续。

note.en: The first group holds the word and two look-alikes, one of them unrelated in origin; the second holds other charges and the words closest in meaning.
note.cn: 第一组是这个单词与两个形近词，其中一个来源无关；第二组是其他收费与最接近的同义词。

entries.definition: Subjected to a tariff; it describes goods or trade rather than the tax itself.
entries.definitionCN: 被征收关税的；它描述货物或贸易，而非税本身。

entries.definition: The act of setting rates or charging according to a schedule, used in regulation and utilities.
entries.definitionCN: 制定费率或按价目表收费的行为，用于监管与公用事业。

entries.definition: The movement of vehicles or goods, from Italian traffico; it looks close to tariff but comes from another word entirely.
entries.definitionCN: 车辆或货物的流动，来自意大利语 traffico；它与 tariff 拼写相近，来源却完全不同。

entries.definition: Free of tariffs; it is a derived adjective, not the tax.
entries.definitionCN: 无关税的；它是派生形容词，不是税本身。

entries.definition: A tax on imports or exports; it is close to tariff but can also mean an obligation.
entries.definitionCN: 对进出口征收的税；与 tariff 接近，但也指义务。

entries.definition: A charge imposed by authority, or the act of imposing it; broader than a border tax.
entries.definitionCN: 当局征收的费用，或征收这一行为；比边境税更宽。

entries.definition: A charge for using a road or a bridge; historically the same idea as a tariff but for traffic.
entries.definitionCN: 使用道路或桥梁所付的费用；历史上与关税同一思路，只是针对通行。

entries.definition: The amount charged per unit; a tariff is a table of such rates.
entries.definitionCN: 每单位收取的金额；关税就是这类费率构成的表。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real parts, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实的固定搭配与真实的同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The word first meant a published list of charges, and a duty is one line in that list.
normal.cn: 这个词最初指公布的收费表，而关税就是表上的一行。

normal.en: The family runs tariff, tariffed, tariffing and tariffless.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 tariff、tariffed、tariffing 与 tariffless。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the border and the utility: import tariff, tariff rate, night tariff.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出边境与公用事业两面：进口关税、税率、夜间电价。

normal.en: Keep tariff and traffic apart: one is a table of charges, the other is movement.
normal.cn: 把关税与交通分开：一个是收费表，一个是流动。

normal.en: A customs officer with a pen on a long table is the picture of the whole word.
normal.cn: 一名关员拿着笔在长表上划线，就是这个词的整体画面。

abstract.en: Picture a menu of charges posted at a border, where each dish is a kind of goods.
abstract.cn: 想象边境上贴着一份收费菜单，每道菜就是一种货物。

abstract.en: Picture two countries each raising a wall one brick higher than the other's.
abstract.cn: 想象两个国家各自把墙砌得比对方高一块砖。

abstract.en: Picture a household meter read at night, with a cheaper column waiting for dark.
abstract.cn: 想象一只家用表在夜里被抄读，表上有一栏更便宜的费率等着天黑。

examples.en: The tariff applies to the stated value of each shipment.
examples.cn: 关税按每批货运申报的价值征收。

examples.en: Farmers asked for a protective tariff on imported grain.
examples.cn: 农民要求对进口谷物征收保护性关税。

examples.en: The utility publishes a separate tariff for night use.
examples.cn: 这家公用事业单位另行公布夜间使用的价目表。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「抬（ta）里（rif）夫」——边境照着费率表抬价收钱 → 关税、税率表

root: 来自阿拉伯语 tarif「通告、估定的收费」，经意大利语 tariffa 与法语 tarif 进入英语；本义是公布的收费表，后指按表征收的关税。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one published table: a duty on imports, the table itself, a protective duty, a retaliatory duty, the rate applied, a utility schedule, a war of duties, and any printed price list.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一张公布的表格展开：进口关税、表格本身、保护性关税、报复性关税、实际适用的税率、公用事业价目表、关税战，以及任何印出的价目表。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long rate table pinned at a customs window, with a pen tracing one line.
core.cn: 核心意象：海关窗口上钉着一张长费率表，一支笔正划过其中一行。

branches.en: THE LINE AND THE LIST: a single duty and the whole table are the same page at two scales.
branches.cn: 一行与整表：单项关税与整张表是同一页纸的两个尺度。

branches.en: A WALL OF PRICE: a protective duty is set to keep goods out rather than to raise money.
branches.cn: 价格的墙：保护性关税是要把货物挡在外面，而不是为了收钱。

branches.en: ANSWER AND ESCALATION: one retaliatory duty repeated becomes a tariff war.
branches.cn: 回应与升级：一项报复性关税反复出现，就成了关税战。

branches.en: THE NUMBER UNDER THE LINE: the rate is what an officer actually applies.
branches.cn: 行下的数字：税率才是关员实际执行的东西。

branches.en: BILLS AND MENUS: a utility schedule and a printed price list keep the oldest sense alive.
branches.cn: 账单与菜单：公用事业价目表与印出的价格清单保留了最古老的义项。

intro.en: The word is a single Arabic loan that passed through Italian and French; it has no Latin root, so its parts are best read as the borrowed stem plus English endings.
intro.cn: 这个词是一个经意大利语与法语传来的阿拉伯语借词，没有拉丁词根，因此各部分宜读作「借入的词干」加英语词尾。

latinIntro.en: No Latin root is involved; the source is Arabic, so the Latin entries stay empty.
latinIntro.cn: 这里不涉及拉丁词根；来源是阿拉伯语，因此拉丁语词形一栏留空。

items.example: The list of charges travelled from port to port.
items.exampleCN: 这份收费清单从一个港口传到另一个港口。

items.example: The harbour kept a tariffa for every cargo.
items.exampleCN: 港口为每种货物备有一份费率表。

items.meaning: a duty; a table of rates
items.example: The tariff lists every kind of goods.
items.exampleCN: 税则列出每一种货物。

items.example: Tariffed goods clear more slowly.
items.exampleCN: 被征关税的货物清关更慢。

items.example: Tariffing the network took a full year.
items.exampleCN: 为网络制定费率花了整整一年。

items.example: The two neighbours trade tariffless goods.
items.exampleCN: 这两个邻国互相交易无关税的货物。

items.example: Duty is paid at the border.
items.exampleCN: 税在边境缴纳。

items.structure: Old French costume, from Latin consuetudo (habit)
items.meaning: the office that collects border duties
items.example: Customs checks every declared value.
items.exampleCN: 海关核查每一笔申报价值。

items.example: Each line of the table is a rate.
items.exampleCN: 表上的每一行都是一个费率。

definition_zh: 配额；定额；限额；（按比例分得的）份额
definition_en: a fixed share or amount assigned to a person, group or country, often acting as a limit
core_image: 一只大桶被分成若干等份，每只杯子只准取走贴着自己名字的那一份，多一滴也不行
scene: 合作社的分配会上，会计把全年的收购总量摊到各户，规定每户只能交售属于自己那一份的数量。 At the cooperative meeting the accountant gave each household its quota of the yearly harvest.
sceneCN: 这里指「按规则分得的份额」，对应第 1 个义项：经事先划分后归某一方的定量；句意为会计在会上把全年收购量按户分配，每户只交售自己那一份。画面要点：分配桌、名册、等分的大桶。

pos.zh: 配额；定额；限额（可数，常与 import、sales、immigration 等连用）

derivatives.zh: 多份配额（quota 加复数后缀，语义由单份转为多份）
配额制度（quota 与 system 构成的复合词，指成套的配额安排）
配额抽样（quota 与 sampling 构成的复合术语，指按配额填格的抽样法）
以配额为基础的（quota 加 based 构成的复合形容词，指以配额为运作依据）
不受配额限制的（quota 加 free 构成的复合形容词，指免除配额约束）

senses.title: A share fixed by prior division
senses.titleCN: 事先划分后归某一方的定量
senses.definition: the part of a total that is measured out and assigned to one person or group in advance
senses.definitionCN: 总量中经事先量出并分配给某一个人或群体的那部分
senses.example: At the cooperative meeting the accountant gave each household its quota of the yearly harvest.
senses.exampleCN: 分配会上，会计把全年收购量按户分配，每户得到自己那一份。
senses.why: The Latin source is quota pars, literally 'how great a part', built on quot 'how many', so the word begins as a question about size answered by a fixed number.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语源是 quota pars，字面为「多大的一份」，由 quot「多少」构成；这个词最初就是对大小的提问，答案是一个定数。

senses.title: An official ceiling on imports
senses.titleCN: 官方设定的进口数量上限
senses.definition: a limit set by a government on the quantity of a good that may be imported
senses.definitionCN: 政府规定的某类商品可以进口的数量上限
senses.example: The government placed a quota on imported steel.
senses.exampleCN: 政府对进口钢材设定了配额。
senses.why: Once a share is fixed by authority rather than by custom, it stops being an entitlement and becomes a wall that trade cannot pass.
senses.whyCN: 当份额由官方而不是惯例来确定，它就不再是应得之份，而变成贸易越不过的一道墙。

senses.title: A required output target
senses.titleCN: 必须完成的产量或销售定额
senses.definition: the amount of work, output or sales that a worker or team is required to reach
senses.definitionCN: 要求员工或团队达到的工作量、产量或销售量
senses.example: Sales staff must meet a monthly quota before bonuses are paid.
senses.exampleCN: 销售人员必须先完成月度定额才能拿到奖金。
senses.why: The same fixed number can be read from below: what was a ceiling for imports becomes a floor that output must reach.
senses.whyCN: 同一个定数也可以从下方读：进口的上限，反过来成了产出必须够到的下限。

senses.title: A limit on the number admitted
senses.definition: the maximum number of people allowed into a country, school or programme in a period
senses.definitionCN: 在一定时期内允许进入某国、某校或某项目的最多人数
senses.example: The university keeps a quota for students from overseas.
senses.exampleCN: 这所大学为海外学生保留了固定名额。
senses.why: Counting people rather than goods needs the same instrument: a number agreed beforehand keeps demand from overflowing the gate.
senses.whyCN: 数人与数货物需要同一种工具：事先商定的数字，使需求不会把门挤破。

senses.title: A fixed contribution owed by a member
senses.definition: the set portion of a common cost or supply that each member is obliged to provide
senses.definitionCN: 共同费用或物资中每一成员必须承担的那一份
senses.example: Each branch pays its quota of the association's running costs.
senses.exampleCN: 每个分会承担协会运转费用中属于自己的那一份。
senses.why: When the direction of the flow reverses, the assigned part turns into an obligation: the member owes the number instead of receiving it.
senses.whyCN: 当流向反转，被分配的那一份就变成义务：成员不再是领取这个数字，而是欠下这个数字。

senses.title: A proportional share of posts or seats
senses.titleCN: 按比例保留的席位或职位
senses.definition: a number of places reserved for a category of people in an assembly, workforce or list
senses.definitionCN: 在议会、员工队伍或名单中为某类人预留的席位数
senses.example: The party reserved a quota of seats for women candidates.
senses.exampleCN: 该党为女性候选人保留了固定比例的席位。
senses.why: Division by proportion is the oldest use of the word, and reserved seats are simply that proportion written into a rulebook.
senses.whyCN: 按比例划分是这个词最古老的用法，保留席位不过是把这一比例写进了规则手册。

senses.title: Quota sampling in research
senses.definition: a sampling method that fills each category of a population up to a preset number
senses.definitionCN: 按预设数目把总体中每一类填满的抽样方法
senses.example: The survey used quota sampling to fill each age band.
senses.exampleCN: 这项调查用配额抽样填满各个年龄段。
senses.why: Statistics borrowed the word because the sample is built the way a shipment is built: each cell gets exactly its assigned count.
senses.whyCN: 统计学借用这个词，因为样本的搭建方式如同配货：每个格子里都正好放进被分配的数量。

senses.title: Any measured portion, even of non-material things
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：连非实体之物也被量出的那一份
senses.definition: an allotted amount of something abstract, such as luck, patience or misfortune
senses.definitionCN: 某种抽象之物（如运气、耐心或不幸）被分定的量
senses.example: Every generation seems to have its quota of hardship.
senses.exampleCN: 每一代人似乎都有自己那一份艰难。
senses.why: The abstract sense keeps the arithmetic but drops the goods: whatever can be counted out can also be allotted.
senses.whyCN: 抽象义保留了算术，却去掉了货物：凡能被数出来的东西，也都能被分配。

intro.en: Quota is Latin for 'how great a part'. It is the feminine of quotus 'of what number', from quot 'how many', and it entered English through legal and commercial counting. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: quota 在拉丁语中意为「多大的一份」，是 quotus「第几、若干」的阴性形式，源头为 quot「多少」；它经法律与商业的计算进入英语。年代均为约数。

items.en: Quot was an indeclinable question word meaning 'how many', used in reckoning and in legal formulas.
items.cn: quot 是一个不变化的疑问词，意为「多少」，用于计算与法律套语。

items.en: Quotus 'of what number, which in order' supplied the adjective, and its feminine quota came to mean the part so numbered.
items.cn: quotus 意为「第几的、若干的」，提供形容词；其阴性形式 quota 后来指被这样编号的那一份。

items.en: Legal and estate records used quota pars, literally 'how great a part', for a share fixed by agreement or custom.
items.cn: 法律与田产记录用 quota pars，字面为「多大的一份」，指按协议或惯例定下的份额。

items.en: English took quota as a proportional share, first in accounts and taxation, then in any fixed allowance.
items.cn: 英语在大约 1600 年吸收 quota 表示按比例分得的份额，最初用于账目与税赋，后泛指任何固定配给。

items.en: Immigration quotas in the 1920s and import quotas in the 1930s fixed the modern sense of an official numerical limit; quota sampling followed from the same counting habit.
items.cn: 1920 年代的移民配额与 1930 年代的进口配额，确定了现代「官方数量上限」这一义；配额抽样则出自同一种计数的习惯。

note.en: The first group shares the Latin counting root but diverged in meaning; the second group offers near alternatives for the idea of an allotted amount.
note.cn: 第一组共享拉丁语「计数」词根，但语义已分岔；第二组是「被分配的份额」这一意思的近义替代。

entries.definition: To repeat someone's words or to state a price; it comes from the same counting root but the action is marking or citing, not allotting.
entries.definitionCN: 引用他人的话或报出价格；同出「计数」词根，但动作是标出或引述，而不是分配。

entries.definition: A cited passage or a stated price; the counting root survives only in the idea of marking something down.
entries.definitionCN: 被引用的段落或报出的价格；计数词根只剩「把它标记下来」这一层。

entries.definition: The result of a division; it keeps the 'how many times' question but names an answer in arithmetic, never a share.
entries.definitionCN: 除法所得的结果；它保留「多少次」的提问，但指的是算术答案，从不指份额。

entries.definition: A fixed allowance of food or supplies, from Latin ratio 'reckoning', not from quot; it looks close but belongs to another family.
entries.definitionCN: 食物或物资的定额配给，出自拉丁语 ratio「计算」，并非 quot；形近而属于另一词族。

entries.definition: A portion belonging to one party; it states the division but not that the amount was fixed in advance by an authority.
entries.definitionCN: 属于某一方的部分；它只说划分，不说这个数量是由权威事先定下的。

entries.definition: An amount permitted to a person, often for expenses; it stresses permission rather than proportional division.
entries.definitionCN: 允许某人使用的量，常指费用；它强调许可，而不是按比例划分。

entries.definition: A maximum that may not be exceeded; it captures the limit sense of quota but not the idea of a fair share.
entries.definitionCN: 不得超过的最高限度；它涵盖配额的限额义，但不含「公平一份」的意思。

entries.definition: The process or result of assigning resources; it names the act, while quota names the measured amount.
entries.definitionCN: 分配资源的过程或结果；它指动作，而配额指被量出的数额。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real counting root, the real derived words and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的「计数」词根、真实的派生词与真实固定搭配。

normal.en: Quot means 'how many', so quota is the answer to 'how many for you'.
normal.cn: quot 意为「多少」，quota 就是「你那份是多少」的答案。

normal.en: The same root shows in quotient and quotation, both about counting or marking a number.
normal.cn: 同一词根见于 quotient 与 quotation，两者都与计数或标号有关。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the limit sense: import quota, sales quota, immigration quota.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出限额义：进口配额、销售定额、移民配额。

normal.en: A quota is always a count, never a price: it answers how many, not how much money.
normal.cn: 配额总是数量，不是价格：它回答「多少个」，不回答「多少钱」。

normal.en: The word implies that someone has already done the splitting before you arrive.
normal.cn: 这个词隐含：在你到场之前，已经有人把总量分好了。

abstract.en: Picture a pie cut into equal wedges, each wedge tagged with a name before anyone lifts a fork.
abstract.cn: 想象一块馅饼被切成等份，每份在有人动叉之前就贴上了名字。

abstract.en: Picture a theatre with a block of seats roped off, the rope saying who may sit there.
abstract.cn: 想象剧院里有一排座位被绳子围住，绳子说明了谁可以坐。

abstract.en: Picture a queue at a gate where a counter clicks once for each person and stops at a set number.
abstract.cn: 想象门口排队，计数器每进一人跳一下，到某个数就停住。

examples.en: The fishing fleet exceeded its annual quota by two thousand tonnes.
examples.cn: 捕鱼船队超出年度配额两千吨。

examples.en: A quota on imports pushed buyers toward domestic suppliers.
examples.cn: 进口配额把买家推向国内供应商。

examples.en: She hit her sales quota three weeks before the quarter ended.
examples.cn: 她在季度结束前三周就完成了销售定额。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「括住一份」——先把总量括成若干份，你只拿写着你名字的那一份 → 配额、定额

root: 拉丁 quot「多少」→ quotus「第几、若干」→ quota（pars）「多大的一份」；英语 quota 即「按规则划出的那一份」，同根词有 quotient、quote、quotation。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all rest on one act: a total is measured out before it is used. The measured part then becomes an import ceiling, an output target, an admission cap, a member's contribution, a reserved block of seats, a sampling cell and finally any countable allotment.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都立在一个动作上：总量在被使用之前先被量出。这份量出之物随后成为进口上限、产出目标、准入人数上限、成员应缴份额、保留席位、抽样格子，最后扩展到任何可数的分配。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a barrel divided into equal parts, each cup taking only the part marked with its name.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只桶被分成等份，每只杯子只取贴着它名字的那一份。

branches.en: BASE SHARE: one measured part of a whole, assigned rather than chosen.
branches.cn: 基础份额：整体中被量出的一份，由他人指派而非自己挑选。

branches.en: LIMIT AND TARGET: the assigned number becomes a wall for imports or a floor for output.
branches.cn: 上限与目标：被指派的数量，对进口是墙，对产出是底线。

branches.en: RULES OF ENTRY: a count of people admitted, or a block of seats reserved by proportion.
branches.cn: 准入规则：限定可进入的人数，或按比例预留一批席位。

branches.en: OBLIGATION: the same number reverses direction and becomes what a member owes.
branches.cn: 义务：同一个数字反转方向，成为成员应缴的部分。

branches.en: COUNTING EXTENDED: sampling fills cells by number, and even hardship can be allotted.
branches.cn: 计数外扩：抽样按数目填格，连艰难也能被分配。

intro.en: Quota is a Latin noun built on a question word, and that question word also built several English terms about numbering.
intro.cn: quota 是由一个疑问词构成的拉丁名词，这个疑问词还构成若干英语中与计数有关的词。

latinIntro.en: Latin quot 'how many' gives quota, quotient, quote and quotation, though the last two moved from counting to marking and citing.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 quot「多少」衍生 quota、quotient、quote 与 quotation，后两者已从计数转向标记与引述。

items.meaningCN: 按设定数目填满类别的抽样方法
items.example: Quota sampling kept the age groups balanced.

definition_zh: 批准；认可；制裁；批准（动词）
definition_en: official approval or permission; a penalty imposed to force obedience; to approve or authorize officially
core_image: 一份盖了官印的文件，既给出许可也带有强制力
scene: 政府批准了这项新计划。 The government sanctioned the new plan.
sceneCN: 这里 sanction 是「批准」（第 3 个义项）；句意：政府批准了这项新计划。

senses.title: Official approval
senses.definition: official permission or approval for an action
senses.definitionCN: 对某项行动的官方许可或认可
senses.example: The plan needs the sanction of the council.
senses.exampleCN: 这项计划需要议会批准。
senses.why: The core sense is the authority that makes an act valid.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是使行为有效的权威认可。

senses.title: A penalty
senses.definition: a punishment imposed, often by one country on another, to force obedience
senses.definitionCN: 常指一国对另一国施加、迫使其服从的惩罚措施
senses.example: The country faces tough economic sanctions.
senses.exampleCN: 该国面临严厉的经济制裁。
senses.why: Authority can also punish those who break the rule.
senses.whyCN: 权威也能惩罚违反规则者。

senses.title: To approve officially
senses.definition: to give official approval or permission for something
senses.definitionCN: 对某事给予官方批准或许可
senses.example: The board sanctioned the budget.
senses.exampleCN: 董事会批准了预算。
senses.why: The verb applies the approval sense to an object.
senses.whyCN: 动词义把「批准」这一义项用于具体对象。

intro.en: Sanction comes from Latin sanctio, a decree, from sancire, to make sacred or ratify.
intro.cn: sanction 来自拉丁语 sanctio（法令），源头 sancire 意为使神圣或批准。

items.en: Sancire means to make sacred or confirm.
items.cn: sancire 意为使神圣或确认。

items.en: Sanctio names a binding decree.
items.cn: sanctio 指具有约束力的法令。

items.en: The word passes through legal French.
items.cn: 该词经由法律法语传入。

items.en: English sanction means a confirming law.
items.cn: 十七世纪英语 sanction 指确认性法律。

items.en: The word also means a punitive measure.
items.cn: 现代英语中该词也指惩罚性措施。

note.en: Sanction can mean approval or penalty; section is just a part.
note.cn: sanction 既可指批准也可指制裁，section 只是部分。

entries.definition: one part of something larger
entries.definitionCN: 部分；章节

entries.definition: a place where trains stop
entries.definitionCN: 车站

entries.definition: a small group within a larger one
entries.definitionCN: 派系

entries.definition: official agreement to something
entries.definitionCN: 批准；赞成

entries.definition: a punishment for breaking a rule
entries.definitionCN: 处罚；罚款

entries.definition: an official ban on trade
entries.definitionCN: 禁运

normalIntro.en: Sanction is one word with two opposite faces: permission and punishment.
normalIntro.cn: sanction 一词两面：既是许可，也是惩罚。

normal.en: The minister sanctioned the export deal.
normal.cn: 部长批准了这笔出口交易。

normal.en: The UN imposed sanctions on the regime.
normal.cn: 联合国对该政权实施了制裁。

normal.en: He acted without official sanction.
normal.cn: 他未经官方批准就行动了。

normal.en: The sanctions were lifted last year.
normal.cn: 制裁去年被解除了。

normal.en: The school sanctioned the new club.
normal.cn: 学校批准了这个新社团。

abstract.en: Picture a wax seal that both permits and punishes.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚既授权又惩戒的蜡封。

abstract.en: Imagine a gate opened by a signature.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇由签名打开的闸门。

abstract.en: Think of a heavy fine as the price of breaking rules.
abstract.cn: 把高额罚款想成违规的代价。

examples.en: The project cannot start without official sanction.
examples.cn: 这个项目未经官方批准不能启动。

examples.en: New sanctions target the country's banks.
examples.cn: 新的制裁针对该国的银行。

examples.en: The committee sanctioned the use of the hall.
examples.cn: 委员会批准使用大厅。

dict_mnemonic.note: 词源记忆 · 拉丁词根
dict_mnemonic.text: sanction 源于拉丁语 sancire（使神圣、批准），同族词有 sacred 与 saint，记住「由权威定下并强制执行」。

root: sanction 源自拉丁语 sanctio（法令），来自 sancire（使神圣、批准），与 saint、sacred 同族。

sensesIntro.en: Sanction means official approval, a punitive measure, or to approve officially.
sensesIntro.cn: sanction 指官方批准、惩罚性制裁，或正式批准某事的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an official seal that both permits and punishes.
core.cn: 核心意象：一枚既授权又惩戒的官印。

branches.en: The base sense is official approval.
branches.cn: 基础义是官方批准。

branches.en: The same authority imposes penalties.
branches.cn: 同一权威施加惩罚。

branches.en: The verb turns approval into an action.
branches.cn: 动词义把批准变成动作。

branches.en: Approval and authorizing describe one official act.
branches.cn: 批准与授权描述同一个官方行为。

branches.en: Powers that sanction deals can also sanction states.
branches.cn: 能批准交易的力量也能制裁国家。

intro.en: Sanction belongs to the sanct- family of words about what is sacred or binding.
intro.cn: sanction 属于 sanct- 词族，表示神圣或有约束力的事物。

latinIntro.en: Latin sancire, sanctio, and sanctus form the root family of sanction.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 sancire、sanctio 与 sanctus 构成 sanction 的词根家族。

items.example: They gave their sanction to the plan.
items.exampleCN: 他们批准了这项计划。

items.example: The sanctions hurt the economy.
items.exampleCN: 制裁打击了经济。

items.meaning: approved or subjected to a penalty
items.example: The strike was officially sanctioned.
items.exampleCN: 这次罢工获得官方批准。

items.meaning: the act of approving or penalizing
items.example: Sanctioning such exports is controversial.
items.exampleCN: 批准此类出口颇具争议。

items.example: They held an unsanctioned meeting.
items.exampleCN: 他们举行了一次未经批准的会议。

items.exampleCN: 此类行为可予制裁。

items.example: They defended the sanctity of life.
items.exampleCN: 他们捍卫生命的神圣性。

items.example: The birds found sanctuary in the woods.
items.exampleCN: 鸟儿在树林里找到了庇护。

items.example: The ritual was meant to sanctify the ground.
items.exampleCN: 这个仪式意在使土地神圣。

latinEntries.example: Sancire is the root of sanction.
latinEntries.exampleCN: sancire 是 sanction 的词根。
sanctus 是 saint 的前身。

intro.en: Embargo comes from Spanish embargar, to seize or to bar, built from em- and barra meaning a bar; the word entered English through the seizure of ships.
intro.cn: embargo 来自西班牙语 embargar（扣押；阻拦），由 em- 与 barra（栏杆）构成；这个词经扣押船只之事进入英语。

items.en: Barra means a bar or a rod, the root behind bar and barrier.
items.cn: barra 意为条或杆，是 bar 与 barrier 背后的词根。

items.en: Embargar means to seize or to hinder, from em- plus barra.
items.cn: embargar 意为扣押或阻拦，由 em- 加 barra 构成。

items.en: Embargo is the noun, a seizure or an arrest of ships.
items.cn: embargo 是名词，指扣押或对船只的扣留。

items.en: English borrows embargo in the 1590s for an order stopping ships from leaving port.
items.cn: 英语在 16 世纪 90 年代借入 embargo，指禁止船只离港的命令。

items.en: Embargo extends to a formal ban on trade with a whole country.
items.cn: embargo 扩展到对整国贸易的正式禁令。

items.en: Journalists accept an embargo, a promise not to publish before a set time.
items.cn: 记者接受禁止发表令，即约定时间之前不得发表的承诺。

note.en: Embargo, bar and barrier share the root barra, a rod that blocks the way; ban and blockade are the nearest synonyms.
note.cn: embargo、bar 与 barrier 共享词根 barra（挡路的杆）；ban 与 blockade 是最接近的同义词。

dict_mnemonic.text: embargo ＝ em-（使进入）＋ barra（杆；栏，西班牙语）＝「横上一道杆」。复数 embargoes 或 embargos，动词三单 embargoes、过去式与过去分词 embargoed、现在分词 embargoing。同根 bar 条、阻拦，barrier 障碍，barricade 路障，barrage 弹幕。三层用法：贸易禁运 an arms embargo 武器禁运、an oil embargo 石油禁运、impose an embargo 实施禁运、lift an embargo 解除禁运；封港 an embargo on shipping 禁航令；新闻禁止发表 under embargo 在禁止发表期内、embargoed until Friday 周五前不得发表。近义 ban 泛指禁令，blockade 指用武力封锁，sanction 指惩罚性制裁；embargo 特指官方禁止贸易或禁止发表。注意与 embark（上船；着手）只差一个字母。

root: 拉丁语 barra（杆）→ 西班牙语 em-（使）＋ barra → embargar（扣押；阻拦）→ embargo（禁运）

definition_zh: 保险费；溢价；额外费用；高等的
definition_en: the amount paid for insurance; an extra charge above a standard price; of the highest quality
core_image: 一张保单的顶部，放着一叠比普通钞票更厚更精致的钞票
scene: 小李在比较几份车险报价，最便宜的那份免赔额很高，贵一点的那份保费就贵了二十块。 The monthly premium for the comprehensive policy was steep.
sceneCN: 这里 premium 指「保险费」（第 1 个义项：被保险人定期支付给保险人的金额）；句意为全保保单的月保费很高。图中可辨识物件：保单报价单、计算器、钞票。

pos.zh: 保险费（可数）；溢价（可数/不可数）

senses.title: insurance payment
senses.definition: a regular payment to an insurer in exchange for insurance cover
senses.definitionCN: 为换取保险保障而定期向保险人支付的金额
senses.example: She paid the premium once a year in advance.
senses.exampleCN: 她每年提前一次付清保费。
senses.why: This is the most common financial sense; the premium is what you 'pay for the prize' of cover.
senses.whyCN: 这是最常见的财务义；premium 就是你为保障的「奖赏」所付的钱。

senses.title: extra price above standard
senses.definition: an amount paid over and above the usual or base price
senses.definitionCN: 高于通常或基准价格的那部分金额
senses.example: You pay a premium for a seat with extra legroom.
senses.exampleCN: 腿部空间大的座位要多付钱。
senses.why: You pay more for something better, a 'prize' of better quality.
senses.whyCN: 更好的东西多付钱，一种更好质量的「奖赏」。

senses.title: reward or prize
senses.definition: an extra amount paid to encourage performance
senses.definitionCN: 为鼓励表现而额外支付的金额
senses.example: Workers got a premium for working the night shift.
senses.exampleCN: 上夜班的工人有额外奖金。
senses.why: Premium was originally Latin for a reward or prize.
senses.whyCN: premium 原本在拉丁语里就是奖赏或奖品的意思。

senses.title: stock trading price above par
senses.definition: the amount a security trades above its face value
senses.definitionCN: 证券以高于其面值交易的金额
senses.example: The bond sold at a ten percent premium.
senses.exampleCN: 这支债券以高于面值百分之十的价格出售。
senses.why: When the market pays more than face value, that extra is the premium.
senses.whyCN: 市场支付的比面值高出来的那部分就是 premium。

senses.title: high quality adjective
senses.definition: of the highest quality or most expensive grade
senses.definitionCN: 最高质量或最贵等级的
senses.example: They stayed at a premium hotel near the airport.
senses.exampleCN: 他们住在机场附近的一家高档酒店。
senses.why: Adjective use from the 'best, extra' sense.
senses.whyCN: 来自「最好的、额外的」义的形容词用法。

senses.title: premium on your time
senses.definition: high value or importance placed on something scarce
senses.definitionCN: 给予稀缺事物的高价值或重要性
senses.example: In a startup, every minute is at a premium.
senses.exampleCN: 在创业公司里，每一分钟都很宝贵。
senses.why: Scarce things carry an extra price, so they are 'at a premium'.
senses.whyCN: 稀缺的东西都有额外价格，所以它们「at a premium」。

senses.title: options premium
senses.definition: the price paid for an options contract in finance
senses.definitionCN: 金融中为期权合同支付的价格
senses.example: The premium on the call option was three dollars.
senses.exampleCN: 这支看涨期权的权利金是三美元。
senses.why: Another financial use: what you pay to buy the right to trade.
senses.whyCN: 另一种金融用法：你为购买交易权所付的钱。

senses.title: going premium
senses.definition: to become more valuable or scarce in demand
senses.definitionCN: 变得更值钱或更紧俏
senses.example: Rare stamps go premium when collectors bid for them.
senses.exampleCN: 稀有邮票在集邮者竞价时变得紧俏。
senses.why: The extra price you would pay shows how sought after it is.
senses.whyCN: 你愿意多付的那部分就说明它有多抢手。

intro.en: Premium comes from Latin praemium 'reward, prize'. The 'insurance payment' sense developed by analogy: you pay a small amount to get a big prize (compensation) if loss hits.
intro.cn: premium 来自拉丁语 praemium「奖赏、奖品」。保险费义是类比而来：你付一小笔钱，遭遇损失时就能获得一大笔「奖赏」（赔偿）。

items.en: Latin praemium meant 'reward, prize, money given as an incentive'.
items.cn: 拉丁语 praemium 意为「奖赏、奖品、作为激励的钱」。

items.en: Middle French premie 'reward' came from Latin praemium.
items.cn: 中古法语 premie「奖赏」来自拉丁语 praemium。

items.en: English borrowed premium around 1600 meaning 'reward, prize'.
items.cn: 英语约 1600 年借入 premium，意为「奖赏、奖品」。

items.en: The 'insurance payment' sense emerged by analogy with a prize around 1660, when early marine insurance spread.
items.cn: 保险费义约 1660 年通过与奖赏的类比出现，那时早期海上保险在发展。

items.en: The 'extra price' sense appeared in the 18th century; adjective use 'best quality' in the 19th.
items.cn: 「额外价格」义在 18 世纪出现；形容词「优质」义在 19 世纪。

items.en: Etymology solid; Latin praemium is well attested in inscriptions.
items.cn: 词源可靠；拉丁语 praemium 在铭文里有充分佐证。

note.en: Look-alikes are other -ium Latin nouns; near meanings are prices, rewards or charges.
note.cn: 形近是其他以 -ium 结尾的拉丁语名词；近义是价格、奖赏或收费。

entries.definition: Hatred; Latin odium 'hatred', unrelated to premium.
entries.definitionCN: 憎恨；来自拉丁语 odium，与 premium 无关。

entries.definition: A middle or a means; from Latin medius 'middle'.

entries.definition: Any charge for a service; premium is specifically an insurance payment or extra price.

entries.definition: An extra charge added to a base price.
entries.definitionCN: 加在基准价上的额外收费。

entries.definition: An extra payment for performance; premium is what you pay, bonus what you get.
entries.definitionCN: 因表现好而额外得到的钱；premium 是你付出去的，bonus 是你拿到的。

entries.definition: The premium in options trading is the price of the contract.
entries.definitionCN: 期权交易中的 premium 就是合同价格。
